chapter.name: Kshetra Kshetrajna Vibhaga Yoga
chapter.englishName: Yoga of the Distinction between Field and Knower of the Field
chapter.description: Krishna explains the difference between the body (field) and the soul (knower of the field), describing the nature of knowledge, matter, consciousness, and the ultimate reality.
chapter.theme: Understanding the body, soul, and true knowledge leading to self-realization
chapter.yogaType: Jnana Yoga - Yoga of Knowledge and Wisdom

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च | एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñam eva ca | etad veditum icchāmi jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ ca keśava ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: I wish to know about nature, the soul, the field, the knower of the field, knowledge, and the object of knowledge.
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks understanding of reality and consciousness.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते | एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | idaṃ śarīraṃ kaunteya kṣetram ity abhidhīyate | etad yo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tad-vidaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: This body is called the field, and one who knows it is the knower of the field.
verses.meaning: The body is distinct from the conscious self.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत | क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम ||
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarva-kṣetreṣu bhārata | kṣetra-kṣetrajñayor jñānaṃ yat taj jñānaṃ mataṃ mama ||
verses.english_translation: Know Me as the knower in all fields; true knowledge is understanding this distinction.
verses.meaning: God is the supreme consciousness in all beings.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् | स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु ||
verses.transliteration: tat kṣetraṃ yac ca yādṛk ca yad vikāri yataś ca yat | sa ca yo yat-prabhāvaś ca tat samāsena me śṛṇu ||
verses.english_translation: Hear briefly about the field, its nature, and its transformations.
verses.meaning: Krishna begins explaining matter and body.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् | ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः ||
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhir bahudhā gītaṃ chandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛthak | brahma-sūtra-padaiś caiva hetumadbhir viniścitaiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: This knowledge has been described by sages and scriptures.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च | इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ||
verses.transliteration: mahā-bhūtāny ahaṅkāro buddhir avyaktam eva ca | indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriya-go-carāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The field includes elements, ego, intellect, senses, and sense objects.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतना धृतिः | एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaś cetanā dhṛtiḥ | etat kṣetraṃ samāsena savikāram udāhṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, and consciousness are part of the field.
verses.meaning: Mental and emotional aspects belong to the body.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् | आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ||
verses.transliteration: amānitvam adambhitvam ahiṃsā kṣāntir ārjavam | ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyam ātma-vinigrahaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Humility, non-violence, patience, purity, and self-control are knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च | जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ||
verses.transliteration: indriyārtheṣu vairāgyam anahaṅkāra eva ca | janma-mṛtyu-jarā-vyādhi-duḥkha-doṣānudarśanam ||
verses.english_translation: Detachment and awareness of suffering are knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु | नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु ||
verses.transliteration: asaktir anabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putra-dāra-gṛhādiṣu | nityaṃ ca sama-cittatvam iṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu ||
verses.english_translation: Non-attachment and equanimity are knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी | विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ||
verses.transliteration: mayi cānanya-yogena bhaktir avyabhicāriṇī | vivikta-deśa-sevitvam aratir jana-saṃsadi ||
verses.english_translation: Steady devotion and love for solitude are knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् | एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा ||
verses.transliteration: adhyātma-jñāna-nityatvaṃ tattva-jñānārtha-darśanam | etaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṃ yad ato 'nyathā ||
verses.english_translation: True knowledge is understanding the self; all else is ignorance.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते | अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: jñeyaṃ yat tat pravakṣyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛtam aśnute | anādi mat-paraṃ brahma na sat tan nāsad ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: I will describe the knowable, knowing which one attains immortality.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् | सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ||
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādaṃ tat sarvato 'kṣi-śiro-mukham | sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||
verses.english_translation: The Supreme exists everywhere with hands, feet, eyes, and ears.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् | असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ||
verses.transliteration: sarvendriya-guṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriya-vivarjitam | asaktaṃ sarva-bhṛc caiva nirguṇaṃ guṇa-bhoktṛ ca ||
verses.english_translation: The Supreme is beyond senses yet supports them all.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च | सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ||
verses.transliteration: bahir antaś ca bhūtānām acaraṃ caram eva ca | sūkṣmatvāt tad avijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat ||
verses.english_translation: The Supreme exists both inside and outside all beings, moving and unmoving.
verses.meaning: God is both immanent and transcendent.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् | भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ||
verses.transliteration: avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktam iva ca sthitam | bhūta-bhartṛ ca taj jñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca ||
verses.english_translation: Though undivided, it appears divided among beings and sustains them.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते | ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ||
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param ucyate | jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñāna-gamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam ||
verses.english_translation: It is the light of all lights, beyond darkness, residing in all hearts.
verses.meaning: The divine is the ultimate source of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः | मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ||
verses.transliteration: iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ | mad-bhakta etad vijñāya mad-bhāvāyopapadyate ||
verses.english_translation: Thus, the field, knowledge, and the knowable have been explained.
verses.meaning: Understanding leads to union with God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि | विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान् ||
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api | vikārāṃś ca guṇāṃś caiva viddhi prakṛti-sambhavān ||
verses.english_translation: Nature and spirit are beginningless; all transformations arise from nature.
verses.meaning: Matter causes change; spirit is eternal.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कार्यकरणकर्तृत्वे हेतु: प्रकृतिरुच्यते | पुरुष: सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: kārya-karaṇa-kartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtir ucyate | puruṣaḥ sukha-duḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve hetur ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: Nature is the cause of action; the soul experiences pleasure and pain.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पुरुष: प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् | कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ||
verses.transliteration: puruṣaḥ prakṛti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛti-jān guṇān | kāraṇaṃ guṇa-saṅgo 'sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu ||
verses.english_translation: Attachment to qualities causes rebirth in good and bad forms.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वर: | परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुष: पर: ||
verses.transliteration: upadraṣṭānumantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ | paramātmeti cāpy ukto dehe 'smin puruṣaḥ paraḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The Supreme is the witness, supporter, and enjoyer in the body.
verses.meaning: God resides within as the supreme soul.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणै: सह | सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते ||
verses.transliteration: ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha | sarvathā vartamāno 'pi na sa bhūyo 'bhijāyate ||
verses.english_translation: One who understands this is not reborn.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना | अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे ||
verses.transliteration: dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecid ātmānam ātmanā | anye sāṅkhyena yogena karma-yogena cāpare ||
verses.english_translation: Some realize through meditation, others through knowledge or action.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्त: श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते | तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ||
verses.transliteration: anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate | te 'pi cātitaranty eva mṛtyuṃ śruti-parāyaṇāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Even those who follow teachings with faith transcend death.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यावत्संजायते किंचित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् | क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ||
verses.transliteration: yāvat sañjāyate kiṃcit sattvaṃ sthāvara-jaṅgamam | kṣetra-kṣetrajña-saṃyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣabha ||
verses.english_translation: All beings arise from the union of field and knower.
verses.meaning: Creation comes from matter and consciousness.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् | विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं य: पश्यति स पश्यति ||
verses.transliteration: samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram | vinaśyatsv avinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ||
verses.english_translation: One who sees the same divine in all beings truly sees.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् | न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: samaṃ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśvaram | na hinasty ātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
verses.english_translation: Seeing God equally, one does not harm others and attains liberation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः | य: पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ||
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ | yaḥ paśyati tathātmānam akartāraṃ sa paśyati ||
verses.english_translation: Actions are performed by nature; the self is non-doer.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति | तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ||
verses.transliteration: yadā bhūta-pṛthag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśyati | tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā ||
verses.english_translation: Seeing unity in diversity leads to realization of Brahman.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः | शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते ||
verses.transliteration: anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ | śarīra-stho 'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate ||
verses.english_translation: The soul is eternal, beyond qualities, and unaffected by actions.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते | सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते ||
verses.transliteration: yathā sarva-gataṃ saukṣmyād ākāśaṃ nopalipyate | sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate ||
verses.english_translation: Like space, the soul remains untouched despite being everywhere.
verses.meaning: The self is unaffected by the body.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः | क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ||
verses.transliteration: yathā prakāśayaty ekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokam imaṃ raviḥ | kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata ||
verses.english_translation: Like the sun illuminates the world, the soul illuminates the body.
verses.meaning: Consciousness gives life to the body.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा | भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम् ||
verses.transliteration: kṣetra-kṣetrajñayor evam antaraṃ jñāna-cakṣuṣā | bhūta-prakṛti-mokṣaṃ ca ye vidur yānti te param ||
verses.english_translation: Those who understand the distinction between field and knower attain the supreme.
